chunks: Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad, from Harun ibn Muslim, from al-Husayn ibn 'Ulwan, from 'Abd Allah ibn al-Hasan ibn 'Ali ibn Abi Talib عليه السلام, from his forefathers عليهم السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: “Everything that chews the cud—its leftover water is halal, and its saliva is halal.”
As for that which indicates the permissibility of using the leftover water of birds.

key_terms.أَسْآرِ: leftover water remnants from animals after drinking
key_terms.حَلَالٌ: permissible and lawful in this legal context
key_terms.سُؤْرُهُ: its leftover water or remainder after drinking

ai.seo_question: What does Tahdhib al-Ahkam say about the leftover water and saliva of animals and birds?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal ruling concerning purity and permissibility, stating that the leftover water and saliva of cud-chewing animals are halal. It appears in the context of rulings on waters and what may be used for purification, and is cited as evidence regarding the permissibility of using the leftover water of birds.
